open.title: Shelves in the pantry bay
open.overview: Seven fixed shelves of poplar for the jars, the bottom one left high enough for the crock.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: The bay is thirty one inches wide and fifty two deep. Seven shelves at eleven inches gives the tall jars room.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: Poplar boards, seven at eight foot, came to ninety four dollars. The cleats are cut from the offcuts.
